patch.sql:
select
    o_orderkey as order_key,
    o_custkey as customer_key,
    o_orderstatus as order_status,
    o_totalprice as total_price,
    o_orderdate as order_date,
    o_orderpriority as priority,
    _loaded_at as loaded_at
from {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
where o_orderdate >= date '{{ var("as_of") }}' - interval 30 day
patch.explanation: The freshness test expects recent orders within the last 30 days, but stg_orders filtered for dates older than that (using <). Raw orders contain only dates up to 1998, so no recent rows exist, causing the test to fail. Changing the filter to >= captures recent orders (if any) and aligns with the test.
